page_title: LEC 0-6 FIO | Lecce v Fiorentina 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

90+1' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' Luca Gotti prepares a substitution. Frederic Guilbert is replaced by Gaby Jean (Lecce).
85' The game has begun to heat up. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
83' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post.
80' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Fourneau had an easy-decision to make.
77' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
75' That's the end of the game for Ylber Ramadani (Lecce), who is replaced by Mohamed Kaba.

72' 0 - 6 Goal! Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) neatly controls a decent pass from Andrea Colpani. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the left side of the goal from the edge of the box. 0:6.

68' Riccardo Sottil smashes in a cross, but Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
68' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
67' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
67' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francesco Fourneau who sees an offensive foul.
66' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) will be replaced by Fabiano Parisi.
64' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) works the corner short.
63' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle and it's Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
62' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
61' 0 - 5 What a hit! Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 0:5.

60' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the bottom right corner, but David de Gea makes a nice save.
59' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

58' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Yacine Adli.
57' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Riccardo Sottil replaces Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina).
54' 0 - 4 Goal! Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top left corner. 0:4.
54' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) latched on to a fine crossfield pass on the edge of the box and lashed a shot straight at the goalkeeper, who made an easy save.
52' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
47' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
46' Half-time substitution. Luca Gotti decided to make a change. Ante Rebic is replaced by Tete Morente (Lecce).
46' Luca Gotti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Lassana Coulibaly comes on the pitch for Balthazar Pierret (Lecce).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Remi Oudin comes off for Lameck Banda (Lecce).
46' Half-time substitution. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) will not participate anymore and Christian Kouame is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Francesco Fourneau has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

45' 0 - 3 Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) was a bit lucky to score a goal there. He got to the ball from the free kick and produced an accurate shot from just outside the penalty area into the right side of the target.
43' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
42' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
38' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) takes the corner which is cleared.

34' 0 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Wladimiro Falcone, so the score changes to 0:2.
29' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
27' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
21' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) sends a chip pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone is quickest to intercept the ball.
21' It seemed like Remi Oudin (Lecce) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Edoardo Bove tees up Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
18' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.

16' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
16' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
15' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul after Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) hacks down one of his opponents. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lecce.
14' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is caught offside!
10' Remi Oudin (Lecce) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
9' Problems for Raffaele Palladino as Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lucas Beltran replaces him.
7' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
6' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but David de Gea has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau is the one to supervise the game today.
